_note: A Map v3 region (MAP_README.md). bbox [west, south, east, north] in degrees; the projection is a transverse Mercator centred on it. osm: the OpenStreetMap extract to clip it from (Geofabrik), and the fallback when that can't be downloaded (Overture's OSM-derived data, rebuilt as an .osm.pbf). dem: elevation sources, best first; each a bare-earth DTM (never a surface model) with its horizontal and vertical datum, converted to EGM2008 heights; blendBand: metres over which a better source fades into the next. spots: quick-travel places (auto: found in the data).

demV5._note: Map v5's elevation (map/bake/elevationV5.ts; MAP_V5_DIAGNOSIS.md): best first. lidar-local: GeoTIFFs dropped into .cache/map/dem/<dir>/ (ELVIS's 1 m DEM; MGA zone 54, AHD) — none yet; terrain-tiles: Geoscience Australia's 5 m LiDAR DEM through AWS's terrain tiles, only where it's the 5 m data itself (native) and agrees with the 30 m models at its survey's edge; copernicus: Copernicus GLO-30 (a surface model; corrected under buildings and roads), its canopy capped by dems (GA's vegetation-removed DEM-S). crs: the source's own with its vertical datum, converted to EGM2008 by PROJ (AUSGeoid2020 for AHD, the EGM96 grid for EGM96: .cache/map/proj/).
